title: Bound one-field typed compression of two public MOVEs
body:
On exact #7334, the adjacent public MOVEs at clocks 32944 and 32945 apply the same rank-five chart 3→117 quotient to two independent dirty inputs. Each quotient is a monomial conjugate of five independent Gaussian C axes. At every admitted width the pair’s identity-erased displacement is at least 11/8 of one ambient field. At width four, arbitrary unitary monomial erasure across both lanes still requires at least 1023/1024 of that field, while a normalized rank-one through rank-six core supplies at most 7/8. Free linear routing is granted. The relaxed price was +67.66946959214 raw before adapters, with no realized saving. **NO VERIFIED GAIN.**

From a clean POSIX checkout, run `python3.12 -I -B research/p104-two-move-typed-volume-bound/replay.py`. The path-keyed package pins the exact word and both Gaussian engines. Exact replay, all 512 one-slice columns, a corrupted-core control, registered checks, exact commit modes, Git-free read-only export and all 27 onboarding tests passed locally. Nonmonomial erasure, a larger field and a different core remain open.

#7334/#7113 supply the comparator and caller. #7414 establishes the exact pair and independent source rows. #7245 and #7406 supply related typed-fusion and identity-erasure precedents. OpenAI Codex and its subagents materially assisted proof, implementation and independent verification.
